headline: Week 4 Detonation: Ogugua Drops 193, Kirkumcised Rolls to 7-1
html:
Week 4 Detonation: Ogugua Drops 193, Kirkumcised Rolls to 7-1

Week 4 delivered one full-scale demolition, one narrow escape and enough scoreboard pain to keep the group chat radioactive. OguguaAnunoby erupted for a league-high 193.46 points, while Kirkumcised Penix improved to a league-best 7-1. At the bottom, Pukakke and Chef Boyardee met in a battle where somebody technically had to win.

Week 4 Matchup Recaps

OguguaAnunoby 193.46, arupert12 135.00

OguguaAnunoby posted the highest score of the week and crushed arupert12 by 58.46 points. It was the fantasy equivalent of showing up to a neighborhood cookout with a professional catering staff. Ogugua moved to 6-2, while arupert12 fell to 3-5 despite producing a respectable 135.00.

alexvandeusen 171.82, Allen town 136.82

alexvandeusen delivered the week’s second-highest score and handed Allen town a 35-point loss. The victory pushed alexvandeusen to 5-3 and strengthened an already impressive scoring profile. Allen town remains 6-2, but this was a reminder that a shiny record does not come with complimentary scoreboard insurance.

Kirkumcised Penix 162.42, RoCknCoCk Crashouts 127.50

Kirkumcised Penix kept the league’s best record rolling with a comfortable 34.92-point victory. At 7-1, the standings leader continues to turn unfortunate opponents into weekly paperwork. RoCknCoCk Crashouts dropped to 4-4 and exited Week 4 with a perfectly balanced record and a decidedly unbalanced result.

Secret service chat 128.40, Chase’n Skattehoes 117.74

Secret service chat survived the closest game of the week, winning by 10.66 points. Neither side broke 130, but style points are not listed in the standings. Secret service chat reached 4-4, while Chase’n Skattehoes slipped to 3-5 after coming close enough to be annoyed but not close enough to celebrate.

Pukakke 117.38, Chef Boyardee 104.38

Pukakke escaped the basement showdown with a 13-point victory, leaving both teams at 1-7. Chef Boyardee recorded the lowest score of Week 4 at 104.38. This matchup did not threaten the weekly scoring record, but it did provide elite tension for anyone fascinated by structural damage.

Week 4 Superlatives

  • Biggest Win: OguguaAnunoby over arupert12 by 58.46 points.
  • Closest Game: Secret service chat over Chase’n Skattehoes by 10.66 points.
  • Highest Score: OguguaAnunoby with 193.46.
  • Lowest Score: Chef Boyardee with 104.38.

Official SBF Network Power Rankings

Rank Team Record Power Score Official Read
1 OguguaAnunoby 6-2 96 Elite 6-2 record, league-best scoring, 193.46 current output, and a deep lineup led by Jahmyr Gibbs, Drake London, and George Kittle.
2 Kirkumcised Penix 7-1 93 League-best 7-1 record with a strong current week and a formidable core of CeeDee Lamb, James Cook, Derrick Henry, and Travis Kelce.
3 alexvandeusen 5-3 89 Second-highest total scoring, a 5-3 record, and 171.82 current points complement Christian McCaffrey, Joe Burrow, Nico Collins, and Brock Bowers.
4 Allen town 6-2 85 A 6-2 record and elite Josh Allen-Bijan Robinson foundation provide a strong outlook, though overall and recent scoring trail the top three.
5 Secret service chat 4-4 76 Balanced 4-4 results and solid scoring pair well with Jaxon Smith-Njigba, Ashton Jeanty, Dak Prescott, and Davante Adams, despite two players on IR.
6 RoCknCoCk Crashouts 4-4 73 A 4-4 record and strong Amon-Ra St. Brown, Trey McBride, and Kyren Williams core offset modest scoring and A.J. Brown's IR designation.
7 arupert12 3-5 69 Strong scoring for a 3-5 team and excellent talent led by Jonathan Taylor and Patrick Mahomes, but Justin Jefferson's absence lowers the current outlook.
8 Chase’n Skattehoes 3-5 54 A 3-5 record, low total scoring, and multiple players listed out limit a roster still featuring Ja'Marr Chase, Chase Brown, and George Pickens.
9 Chef Boyardee 1-7 36 Malik Nabers, Tyler Warren, and Garrett Wilson offer upside, but a 1-7 record, low scoring, Saquon Barkley's absence, and thin healthy depth hurt.
10 Pukakke 1-7 33 Puka Nacua, Lamar Jackson, and Sam LaPorta provide quality, but the 1-7 record and league-low scoring create the weakest current championship outlook.

Fraud Watch

  • Allen town: The 6-2 record remains excellent, but a 136.82-point loss to alexvandeusen exposed the gap between Allen town and the top three on the official board. The badge is shiny; Week 4 was not.
  • RoCknCoCk Crashouts: A 4-4 record, 545.26 total points and a 34.92-point loss make this team difficult to trust. The name promised crashouts, and Week 4 honored the branding.
  • Chef Boyardee: A 1-7 record and the week’s lowest score have turned the kitchen into a code inspection. At some point, the sauce has to score more than 104.38.

Stock Up

  • OguguaAnunoby: League-best 633.16 total points, a 193.46 Week 4 eruption and the official No. 1 ranking. That is not momentum; that is a warning siren.
  • alexvandeusen: A 171.82-point victory pushed the team to 5-3 and reinforced its No. 3 power ranking.
  • Kirkumcised Penix: Another convincing win moved the standings leader to 7-1. The league’s best record remains securely attached.
  • Secret service chat: The score was not explosive, but a win is a win. Reaching 4-4 keeps the season firmly alive.

Stock Down

  • arupert12: Scoring 135.00 is normally survivable. Running into 193.46 is less a matchup and more a scheduled disaster.
  • Allen town: Still 6-2, but Week 4 ended with a 35-point reality check.
  • Chase’n Skattehoes: A 10.66-point loss dropped the team to 3-5, with only 495.52 total points through the current standings.
  • Chef Boyardee: The league’s lowest Week 4 score and a seventh loss. Dinner has been delayed indefinitely.

Weekly Awards

  • Team of the Week: OguguaAnunoby for scoring 193.46 and delivering the largest victory.
  • Statement Win Award: alexvandeusen for beating a 6-2 Allen town squad by 35 points.
  • Business as Usual Award: Kirkumcised Penix for improving to 7-1 with a 162.42-point performance.
  • Cardiac Finish Award: Secret service chat for surviving the week’s closest matchup by 10.66 points.
  • Basement Escape Hatch: Pukakke for earning its first win in the supplied standings by defeating Chef Boyardee.
  • Paper Bag Performance: Chef Boyardee for the week-low 104.38 points.
